description: investigate and decompose goal: Edit repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/vessel-mitosis-cutover.ts to refuse a cutover whose diff deletes a load-bearing evidence comment while making no behavioural change in the same hunk. Measured case: substrate-authored commit 3e58e73 removed a 20-line comment from getCanonicalPosteriors in activity-api that recorded measured row counts and an explicit do-not-simplify-this-back warning, while preserving behaviour exactly; typecheck, shape-dispatch, the semantic gate and the post-land suite all passed it, because no gate reads what a diff REMOVES. Add a check over the staged diff that flags removed comment lines carrying measurements, row counts, or explicit warnings when the same hunk has no non-comment change, and refuse the cutover with that reason unless the proposal justifies the deletion.
